newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK POSTOVA BANKA TO LEAD POST OFFICE BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK POSTOVA BANKA TO LEAD POST OFFICE BOND ISSUE.

text.p: Slovak commercial bank Postova Banka a.s. on Thursday said it would manage a 5-year 400 million crown bond issue at the end of April, for the state-owned post office company Slovenska Posta (SP) s.p..
"Details of the bond are still preliminary, as they must be officialy aproved by the SP's board," Peter Parovsky head of the capital markets department at Postova Banka told Reuters.
He said the issue would have an interest rate "between 12 to 13.5 percent" and will be offered primarily to the Slovak domestic investors. -- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
